input.focus: Research up to 3 named speakers relevant to industrial fabrication operations or production-progress visibility. Include company, role, actual session topic, eventName, sources, LinkedIn only if corroborated, and a draft with unapproved product/pilot claims bracketed.

result.summary: Researched three officially listed speakers for the upcoming FABTECH 2026 edition (October 21–23, Las Vegas): Rutherford Wilson, Alex Doerner, and Alexander Klimov. All three are vendor-side speakers, not identified industrial-owner buyers.
result.coverage: Used 3 searches and 5 page-fetch attempts. The official FABTECH speaker directory and conference/session pages were reviewed via official search-index excerpts, but direct fetches of the supplied speaker page, conference page, and three session pages returned 403/JavaScript-cookie blocks. Official search results for FABTECH’s homepage confirmed the 2026 edition dates and Las Vegas Convention Center location. Session pages checked: F055 (Rutherford Wilson), F096 (Alex Doerner), and F052 (Alexander Klimov). Public LinkedIn search results were checked for profile corroboration; Alex Doerner’s profile/company match was not clear enough to include a URL. Results are partial where direct page verification was blocked.
warnings: Speaker names, affiliations, roles, and session titles are based on official FABTECH indexed excerpts because the official pages could not be opened directly; verify against the live agenda before outreach.
Confirmed speaker means listed by the organizer for the upcoming edition, not that the person has already attended or spoken.

These speakers are vendor-side; topical fit does not establish purchase intent, budget authority, or technical fit. Outreach drafts retain unapproved outcome, mechanism, and pilot claims as bracketed placeholders.
